profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, Germany, this accommodation and food service provider has expanded its operations by 120% since its baseline, driven by increasing demand for its specialized services. As a Scaler, the company's growth is fueled by its ability to adapt to changing consumer preferences and deliver high-quality experiences. With 22 employees in 2024, the company continues to build on its success, solidifying its position in the German market.
